<thought>We need to search the template catalog using the correct functional group names from the allowed list. The broken functional groups are “ketones” and “C‑C triple bonds”. We'll query with those and a small limit.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
